_about: 2-Butanol (1) + MTBE (2): isobaric T-x-y at 90.1 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-butanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
